signature.name: VTask.sym
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> (n : ℕ) -> List α → List (Sym α n)

conventions.statement: VTask.sym 0 [] = [Sym.nil]: the empty source list still yields the unique 0-tuple.
conventions.note: Base case: degree 0 always produces exactly one output regardless of the source list.

conventions.statement: VTask.sym n [] = [] for any n ≥ 1: no tuples can be formed from an empty list when a positive number of elements is required.
conventions.note: Recursive base case on the list.

conventions.statement: The order of elements in the output list is determined by the recursive structure and the order of elements in xs; no sorted or canonical ordering is guaranteed.
conventions.note: Only membership and cardinality properties are canonical, not position.

facts.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (xs : List ℕ), (VTask.sym n xs).length = Nat.choose (xs.length + n - 1) n

facts.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {α : Type} (xs : List α), xs.Nodup → (VTask.sym n xs).Nodup
